LESSON: SOIL ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.5: Soil ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Soil ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when house hold items, houses, huts soil?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. play with soil for enjoyment and exploration,
2. appreciate playing with soil for enjoyment. safety when handling soil Core-Competences to be developed:

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. play with soil for enjoyment and exploration,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to play with soil for enjoyment and exploration,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate playing with soil for enjoyment. safety when handling soil Core-Competences to be developed:
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate playing with soil for enjoyment. safety when handling soil Core-Competences to be developed:. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Soil ENVIRONMENT.
2. Explain Soil ENVIRONMENT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Soil ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: play with soil for enjoyment and exploration,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Soil ENVIRONMENT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when house hold items, houses, huts soil?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. play with soil for enjoyment and exploration,
2. appreciate playing with soil for enjoyment. safety when handling soil Core-Competences to be developed:

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
